Qualitative interviews about the outcomes of biogas reactors in Malawi

Source: R/biogasoutcomesmalawi.R
biogasoutcomesmalawi.Rd

This dataset consists of 61 semi-structured interviews with biogas owners in the Southern Region of Malawi. Interviews were conducted over multiple visits to sites over the course of a two-year period between June 2021 and October 2022.

Usage

biogasoutcomesmalawi

Format

A tibble with 5963 rows and 5 variables:

interview_id

The site id where the interview was performed.

interview_date

The date on which the interview was performed.

question_id

The number of the question within each interview. Note: Number of questions differ between interviews.

interviewer

The question asked by the interviewer.

interviewee

The answer given by the interviewee.
